item.title: 19 Aug — Pyth flips the oracle switch
item.description:
What changed for us
- Pyth Core upgraded on August 18 (UTC). Hermes endpoints now require API keys; the Pyth DAO performed contract upgrades (Sui needs a manual swap). Expect brief cutovers and ensure our monitors catch stale or unauthenticated responses. Primary docs flag this as a mandatory change for all Core users.
